Players Committee card image of [[Knowledge And Defense (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table with up to any number of Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/knowledgeanddefense.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
